correctness.rationale: The optimum equivalence is proved by maximum-degree and cycle obstructions in the underlying bipartite edge subgraph. All one-edge Hamilton-path exchanges are classified by endpoints after a cut; this yields degree 4n-5. Triangles through an optimum arise exactly from common deletions or insertions, giving 2n^2-5. Prefix-reversal permutation groups and a suffix swap provide constructive connectivity. The exact independent checker enumerates all rook forests for n=2..4, all Hamilton-path exchange graphs for n=2..5 and reproduces all formulas. Finite checks corroborate, not replace, the all-n argument.

value.rationale: In a natural infinite family the exact optimum induced-forest value does not disclose whether one-for-one reconfiguration is possible. The theorem proves connectivity without any temporary relaxation and quantifies every vertex degree and every exchange triangle, a nontrivial local-geometry invariant relevant to optimum solution navigation. It is not a mere restatement of the maximum-cardinality forest fact and is uniform for all n>=2.
